title: eriogonum deflexum subsp. parryi
intro: Eriogonum deflexum subsp. parryi, commonly known as Parry's buckwheat sage, is a species of flowering plant in the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities that may aid in wound healing and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Parry's buckwheat sage include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although more research is needed to fully understand its medicinal potential and confirm its efficacy.
